_doc: Protection code: answer validation/coercion, parse fallbacks and PARSE_FAILURE replies, fallback_events bookkeeping, router recovery ladders, tool-error catch branches, tool-call screening. Subtracted from core with `loc_count.py --core --no-guard`. Ranges are [start, end, reason]. Kept: STATIC_REPLY, MAX_REACT_ITERATIONS / at-cap handling, plain JSON parse + field pickup, tool bodies, router itself. Reviewed 2026-09-15: langchain's outer try/except wrappers that only log and re-raise are KEPT as core (they recover nothing).
